rankRules.description: The primary source: the IJF's own `rank_name` for the level of the event, matched EXACTLY, mapped to a tier. Every competition on the live list carries one, from a closed set of 24 values. A rank_name absent from here falls through to the name rules.

match.description: Fallback for a rank_name this file does not carry: a case-insensitive substring of the competition NAME. The FIRST matching rule wins, so order matters.

overrides.description: Explicit tier by id_competition, for the events the name rules misname. Overrides win over rules.

title: ijf-competition-tiers
description: How a competition resolves to a level of competition. The IJF list carries the level itself in `rank_name`, so that is matched first; the name rules remain as a fallback for a rank the table has not been taught, and per-competition overrides win over both. The aggregation reports every competition that fell to the default so the table can be extended.
